name: find_calendar_event_by_name
description: Search for calendar events by name using semantic similarity. Returns the top matching events.

inputs.name: event_name
inputs.description: The name or description of the event to search for.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.description: ISO 8601 datetime for the start of the search window. Defaults to 1 year ago.

inputs.name: end_date
inputs.description: ISO 8601 datetime for the end of the search window. Defaults to 1 year from now.

outputs.description: Human-readable list of matching events with similarity scores.

arguments_prompt:
**IMPORTANT: This tool searches a LARGE date range (2 years by default) to find specific events. Use `get_calendar_events` instead for viewing upcoming events.**

This tool finds a calendar event by name using semantic search. It searches broadly (1 year past, 1 year future) to locate recurring events or past events you want to modify/delete.

Arguments:
- event_name: str (required) - The name or description of the event you're looking for (e.g., "Riley's art lessons", "meeting with Martin", "dentist appointment")
- start_date: str (optional) - ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) - Only search for events after this date (default: 1 year ago)
- end_date: str (optional) - ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS) - Only search for events before this date (default: 1 year forward)

**When to use this tool:**
- Finding a specific event to DELETE (e.g., "find the recurring Wednesday art class")
- Finding a specific event to UPDATE (e.g., "find my dentist appointment")
- Locating a past event you need details about
- Searching when you don't know the exact title

**When NOT to use this tool:**
- Viewing upcoming calendar events → use `get_calendar_events` instead
- Checking today's schedule → use `get_calendar_events` instead
- Listing events for next week → use `get_calendar_events` instead

The tool will:
1. Search a 2-year window (or your specified range)
2. Use semantic similarity to match your description
3. Return the top 5 best matching events with full details (id, summary, description, start/end times, recurrence info)

Example usage:
- To find "Riley's art lessons on Wednesdays" for deletion: event_name="Riley art lessons Wednesday"
- To find a past meeting for reference: event_name="team standup", start_date="2025-01-01T00:00:00", end_date="2025-10-01T00:00:00"
